edge_types.name: SANCTIONS
edge_types.description: Source imposes tariffs, export controls, or entity-listing coercion on target.
edge_types.direction_semantics: source imposes the coercive restriction ON target (source is the sanctioning power)

edge_types.name: CONSTRAINS
edge_types.description: Source limits target's freedom of action via chokepoint leverage, denial, or binding conditions (...

attributes.name: lag
attributes.description: Time before the constraint bites: immediate/quarters/years

edge_types.direction_semantics: source constrains/caps the options of target (source holds the leverage)

edge_types.name: PARTNERS_WITH
edge_types.description: Source and target enter a transactional truce, deal, or cooperative arrangement.
edge_types.direction_semantics: source and target are mutual counterparties; direction indicates the initiating party

edge_types.name: REGULATES
edge_types.description: Source exercises governance, licensing, or judicial authority over target.
edge_types.direction_semantics: source holds regulatory/judicial authority OVER target (source rules on target)

edge_types.name: INFLUENCES
edge_types.description: Source shapes target's decisions through lobbying, pressure, or transmission without formal autho...
edge_types.direction_semantics: source exerts informal influence ON target's choices (source is the influencer)

edge_types.name: CUSTOMER_OF
edge_types.description: Source buys critical inputs/compute from target, creating demand-side dependence.
edge_types.direction_semantics: source is the buyer/customer of target (source purchases from target)

edge_types.name: COMPETES_WITH
edge_types.description: Source rivals target for market, capability, or supply position.
edge_types.direction_semantics: symmetric rivalry between source and target; direction is nominal

edge_types.name: FUNDS
edge_types.description: Source provides capital/financing to target (capex, investment rounds).
edge_types.direction_semantics: source supplies capital TO target (source is the funder)

edge_types.name: BACKS
edge_types.description: Source (state) provides political/strategic support and protection to target champion.

edge_types.name: INVESTS_IN
edge_types.description: Source commits capital/facilities into target's jurisdiction (e.g. reshoring FDI).

attributes.name: amount_scale
attributes.description: Order of magnitude of the investment

edge_types.direction_semantics: source directs investment INTO target's economy/jurisdiction (source is the investor)

analysis_summary: 预测核心是2026–2031年'现代重商主义'与'AI资本/算力扩张'的碰撞及其赢家输家。角色阵容实证为 Organization×8、Government×6，故本体以种子类型 Government、Organization 为主干（覆盖全部14个能动主体：美行政、中国、欧盟、国会/最高法院、台湾、连接国等政府方，以及英伟达、台积电、超大规模云、OpenAI/Stargate、美联储、DeepSeek/华为/中芯、韩国存储、ASML等组织方），并按富本体指引新增4个非能动领域类型——StrategicAsset（芯片/算力/稀土/HBM/EUV等被争夺的咽喉资源）、PolicyInstrument（关税/出口管制/25%营收分成/黄金股等制度工具）、MarketSignal（有效关税率/资本开支/10年期收益率/信用利差/数据中心电力等可解算指标）、GeopoliticalEvent（IEEPA裁决/解放日关税/停火及11月27日到期/台海突发等催化事件），使被引用媒体与报告仍归为source而非能动actor。关系类型完整保留种子注入图谱的14条边（SANCTIONS/CONSTRAINS/PARTNERS_WITH/REGULATES/INFLUENCES/CUSTOMER_OF/COMPETES_WITH/FUNDS/BACKS/INVESTS_IN/ALLY_OF/OPPOSES/SUPPLIES/DEPENDS_ON），覆盖对抗、结盟、经济交易、治理、依赖与影响六大语义家族，并为CONSTRAINS等边补充sign/lag等因果属性、为关键边附sentiment/strength/since_date以支持下游typed检索与传导推演。
